name: Pakistan
description: Pakistan from the Indus Valley and Gandhara to the Mughals, British India, partition, war, Bangladesh's split, cricket and today.

checkpoints.name: Indus and Gandhara
checkpoints.note: Farmers lived at Mehrgarh nine thousand years ago and the Indus cities rose. Persians, Greeks and Kushans ruled Gandhara, the home of a great Buddhist art.

checkpoints.name: Sultans and Mughals
checkpoints.note: Arab armies took Sindh in 712. Later Muslim dynasties ruled from Delhi and Lahore, and the Mughals built mosques and gardens.

checkpoints.name: British India
checkpoints.note: Britain took the Punjab in 1849. Iqbal and Jinnah called for a Muslim homeland.

checkpoints.name: Pakistan
checkpoints.note: Pakistan was born in the partition of 1947. Wars with India, army rule and the split of Bangladesh in 1971 followed, and cricket and Sufi music became its joys.
